implementationPlan: Preserve source RuleID and existing ordinary palette.

blur.hubClaim: Secondary/Outlined/Transparent have ControlBlur on by default.
observedSummary: Secondary: ControlBlur on in all four representations, both DisabledState values, all sizes.
Outlined/Transparent/Text: no effects in all four sets and all their variants (480 variants).
Accent/Primary DisabledState=False: no effects except two Mobile inverted Primary Size72 Rectangular variants.
blur.requiredDecision: Is the desired norm the current library matrix, the Hub claim, or an explicitly corrected matrix? Independently decide whether explicit specification allowBackdropBlur=false may override the intrinsic baseline and on which Views/states. Do not silently expand the code API domain.
implementationPlan: Keep component audit baseline independent from specification input.
Read expected true/false/unset independently; unset must not become false.
Resolve ControlBlur by known style key plus effect identity, not arbitrary blur or display-name guessing.
Only an owner-approved exact configuration exception may supersede baseline blur visibility; preserve other effects/style restrictions.
Distinguish absent, hidden, wrong radius/style, unknown evidence and unsupported View.
No inferred Figma default may be promoted to normative authoring source automatically.
